title: Closure under input sign changes
statement: A Boolean function class is closed under negating input variables if, for every number $n$ of coordinates, every input sign vector $z\in\{-1,1\}^n$, and every function $f$ in the class on $n$ coordinates, the function obtained by negating the input variables specified by $z$ also belongs to the class on $n$ coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: $z$ is a sign vector on $n$ coordinates
$f$ is a Boolean function on $n$ coordinates
$f$ belongs to the class at dimension $n$
